# About Orange Logic

Orange Logic is a content orchestration platform that offers digital asset management and media asset management solutions that go beyond traditional DAM and MAM. Since 1998, its platform has helped the world's largest brands, archives, and government agencies manage, govern, and orchestrate content at scale.

[WATCH OUR OVERVIEW](https://www.orangelogic.com/about#)

![Screenshot 2026-10-07 at 6.05.59 PM](https://www.orangelogic.com/hs-fs/hubfs/CB-01%20Images/Our-Story_Our-Purpose.jpg?width=1921&height=1130&name=Our-Story_Our-Purpose.jpg)

## Our Purpose

Orange Logic exists to change how organizations use, protect, and benefit from their digital content. One platform, shaped to each customer, because no two content operations look the same. Through this work, we:

- Power content that advances healthcare and humanitarian work
- Safeguard the assets and integrity of the world's premier brands and archives
- Increase the efficiency and reach of commerce and retail
- Open creative contribution to anyone in an organization, not just the specialists

## Our Mission

### Build the world's most intelligent digital asset management platform

## Our Commitment

Nearly three decades ago, our founder, Karl Facredyn, set out to solve one hard problem: a photo agency drowning in its own digital archive. The system he built to fix it became the Orange Logic platform. That instinct to run toward the complex content problems others avoid still drives every decision we make. Today we're a global company, and the platform has grown as dynamic as the organizations that run on it: Fortune 100 banks, major retail and technology brands, government agencies, and media powerhouses.

- **We take on the hard problems.** The complexity others consider too hard is exactly where we do our best work.
- **We care about our people.** We invest in our employees and in building a culture that values excellence, innovation, creativity, and passion.
- **We answer to customers.** Independent and organically grown, we build for the people who use the product.

![Screenshot 2026-10-07 at 6.08.59 PM](https://www.orangelogic.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Screenshot%202026-10-07%20at%206.08.59%20PM.png?width=2000&name=Screenshot%202026-10-07%20at%206.08.59%20PM.png)

## Our Spirit

How we work matters as much as what we build. Four values shape the way our teams show up for each other and for every customer.

- **Pioneering excellence.** We build for the complex challenges our industries haven't solved yet, not the easy ones.
- **Actions precede words.** Candid conversations, then delivery. We'd rather show it than say it.
- **Customer empowerment.** Our job isn't done when a feature ships; it's done when the customer reaches their goal.
- **Forward-compatible collaboration.** We give customers a voice in what we build now and what comes next to create a DAM that truly grows with them.

![Screenshot 2026-10-07 at 6.11.41 PM](https://www.orangelogic.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Screenshot%202026-10-07%20at%206.11.41%20PM.png?width=2000&name=Screenshot%202026-10-07%20at%206.11.41%20PM.png)
